reason: Conversation 1 immediately identified the door seal as the most likely cause, asked for exactly the right checks (paper test, ice location, model number), then confirmed the diagnosis and gave complete part-ordering advice (freezer seal, model and service number) plus a safe fitting procedure and a reminder to defrost first. Conversation 2 anchored on unsupported diagnoses (blocked drain, auto-defrost heater/thermostat failure) on a static manual-defrost unit, never suggested inspecting the seal until the customer raised it, and its final part advice was a bare one-liner with no guidance on freezer-vs-fridge seal, fitting, or defrosting beforehand.
